time_integrators.new_note: one new opt-in ID under D147 (N2 with (a)), named by its builder in a dated addition to section 10 before its first run; it refuses to run unless X2 is selected

energy_check.cap_source: today's registered value, stage 0's m5.energy_rtol_ars222 (the lead's ruling)
energy_check.I3_rows_keep_their_caps: X2's qualification caps (3e-2 for the plant; the cap control's own)

B_P.source: stage 0's section 0 parity caps (projective's criteria.absolute_caps); no gate cap inherited, gates reported as information

gain_threshold.status: proposed; the user's to confirm before any arm's readings are read

user_decisions_open: whether X2 stands in for branch X's exact booking

reference.other_rows: R3, stage 0's 0.25 ms run of record
reference.error_bound: the difference from the next-coarser arm of its own ladder (rung 0's k = 8; stage 0's R2), valid where the observed order at that row and class from the three finest arms (k = 7, 8, 9; R1, R2, R3) is at least 1; otherwise the row is undetermined
reference.why_not_R3_through_switch: its error there is 0.36 uV and 8.7e-6 in gate, 0.18 and 0.87 of B_A
reference.window_arm_rows: rung 0's k = 9 arm of the same window (records-cf1ca34b; WN in records-58c336c0)

source.check_at_run_time: sha256 recomputed, refused on mismatch; digest, revision and record identity written to each run's inputs

H2.window_import: rule (b), re-based: R3's amounts and channel gates at the start as declared initial values at t = 0, the cue re-timed, ledgers from zero, horizon the window's length

fallback_ii.trigger: per window and rung: X2 refuses the control at that rung
fallback_ii.today: rerun at that rung with X2 off, as a development instrument check
fallback_ii.new: cannot run without X2; keeps X2 on, result reported as it stands
fallback_ii.dt_star: that rung of that window leaves dt* for both IDs
fallback_ii.likely: X2 allows at most max(8, ceil(0.02 |Q|)) out-of-band held steps per run
fallback_ii.collision: fallback (ii) reruns with X2 off, while the new ID refuses without X2; this handling is the draft's choice, for the lead to confirm

full_runs.rows: R3's kept rows on each arm's grid

W0.build: validation/long_duration/worlds.w0 as M5 built it (registration_20261118.json m5 and w0)

reference.error_bound: the difference from the 0.25 ms arm, valid where the observed order at that row and class from the 0.5, 0.25 and 0.125 ms arms is at least 1; otherwise the row is undetermined

readings.pass: completes with every row accepted by the engine's checks (X2 included) and every row of the reading passes, cumulative from t = 0; no row failing but some undetermined makes the reading undetermined
readings.dt_star: the largest rung on the ID's ladder that passes, every finer rung passing too; 'none on the ladder' otherwise
readings.gain: dt*(new) / dt*(today); undefined where either is none
readings.H2_join: (I): window rungs (below 1 ms) read inside their window only (common rows for dt*, their 1 ms rows beside) joined to full-run rungs (1 ms and up) on R3's rows, both read at 1 ms; (S): the full runs alone
also_reported: X2 record: counted steps, q median and distribution, held steps, max sum|a|/F

common.H2_I: R3's rows on the 100 ms grid
common.window_rungs: the common rows inside their window

rows.own: every reference row on the arm's grid, reported beside (favours coarse arms, which see fewer rows)

readings.row_decision: with the reference's bound e and budget b: pass if |d| + e <= b, fail if |d| - e > b, otherwise undetermined

instrument.I1a: on each window, the control at k = 9 against rung 0's k = 9 within the readable floor; the control at k = 2 on WA against R3's kept rows within the floor
instrument.I1b: the new ID's finest arm against today's within the readable floor plus both estimated errors (H2 windows at k = 9; W0 at 0.125 ms)
instrument.I2: the bound exists (observed order at least 1) at the rows that decide each dt*; rows without a bound are undetermined; decides readings, not the instrument

rows.fr3plant-q1_eps_1e-1: control resume admitted; planted resume refused with 'does not hold its state's residual'
rows.cap-control-fr18-fig5net100-16: refused with 'exceeds the registration's cap at accepted step 1'

I3.limit: tests X2's binding and cap, not a misbooking planted inside the new step
I3.run_by: X2's owner, in the ID's landing (the solver is set in X2's own file)
I3.when: on the N2-alone head before stage A is read, and on the final head before any other new-ID arm is read

instrument.I4: the order function on synthetic sequences (rung 0's I1)
instrument.failure: instrument not validated, if I1, I3 or I4 fails

outcomes.gain_at_least_threshold: converged within budget at dt*, development, X2 on
outcomes.between_1_and_threshold: a bounded gain, what binds named
outcomes.at_most_1: no gain; the ID stays opt-in
outcomes.undefined: reported with the side that has no passing rung

prediction.S_gain: any gain is here: H2 past 71.4 ms, W0 past 5.18 ms

stage_A.what: N2 alone, before (a) is built: one measurement past 5 ms on the slow phase
stage_A.control: today's ID at 100 ms (predicted refused at definition)
stage_A.use: reported in section 10; enters no dt*; a refusal goes to the lead before (a) is built
stage_A.head: development only; N2 alone never lands under the final ID's name (D147)
stage_A.after: I3 passes on that head first
